questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The SI unit of force is:
questions.explanation: The SI unit of force is Newton (N). 1 N = 1 kg·m/s².

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: Speed is a:
questions.explanation: Speed is a scalar quantity as it only has magnitude and no direction. Velocity is the corresponding vector.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: Which color of light has the longest wavelength?
questions.explanation: Red light has the longest wavelength (~700 nm) in the visible spectrum. VIBGYOR goes from shortest to longest.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The acceleration due to gravity on Earth's surface is approximately:
questions.explanation: g ≈ 9.8 m/s² on Earth's surface. It is directed towards the center of the Earth.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The chemical formula of water is:
questions.explanation: Water has the chemical formula H₂O — two hydrogen atoms bonded to one oxygen atom.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The atomic number of Carbon is:
questions.explanation: Carbon has atomic number 6 (6 protons in its nucleus). Its mass number is 12.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Which of the following is a noble gas?
questions.explanation: Helium is a noble gas (Group 18). Noble gases have completely filled outer electron shells.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Rust is chemically:
questions.explanation: Rust is hydrated iron(III) oxide: Fe₂O₃·xH₂O. It forms when iron reacts with oxygen and moisture.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: Plants prepare food by the process of:
questions.explanation: Plants prepare food (glucose) through Photosynthesis using sunlight, CO₂, and water.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: The largest organ in the human body is:
questions.explanation: Skin is the largest organ, covering approximately 1.5 to 2 square meters in adults.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: Which gas do plants absorb during photosynthesis?
questions.explanation: Plants absorb Carbon dioxide (CO₂) and release Oxygen (O₂) during photosynthesis.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: Red blood cells are also called:
questions.explanation: RBCs are called Erythrocytes. WBCs are Leucocytes. Platelets are Thrombocytes.
